title: Youth Academy
subtitle: Premium U16 development programme for riders aged 12–16.
readOnly: Premium is inactive. Your academy history and riders are preserved, but management is read-only.
comingSoon: Coming in the next Youth Academy phase

premium.title: Premium Youth Academy
premium.description: Youth Academy is a Premium-only development layer. Premium members can optionally activate an U16 academy with a fixed 16-rider capacity.
premium.staff: Average Youth Academy Director + U16 Head Coach included
premium.scouting: Optional Youth Scout with budget-based scouting range

activation.title: Activate Youth Academy
activation.description: Activation creates your separate U16 academy. You start with six local riders, an average Youth Academy Director and U16 Head Coach. Youth Scout is optional. V1 has no infrastructure requirement.
activation.budgetHelp: This budget funds rider support, staff, scouting, equipment, camps, travel and youth competition costs.

overview.fixedCapacity: Fixed Premium capacity — independent of infrastructure
overview.directorReady: {{name}} is responsible for the Academy programme, operating requests and budget recommendations.

riders.title: Youth Riders
riders.potentialNote: Exact Potential is intentionally hidden. Assessment bands become more reliable as scouting and development information improves.

staff.scoutOptional: Youth Scout is optional. Hire one from Staff to begin active prospect discovery.
staff.directorBonusHelp: Leadership and efficiency improve Academy management. Strong Directors can reduce Youth equipment purchase costs by up to 8%.
staff.coachBonusHelp: Expertise, potential and efficiency improve weekly rider development, workload decisions and race selection.
staff.scoutBonusHelp: Expertise, experience and efficiency improve prospect selection, report confidence and reports produced per search.
staff.levelScaleHelp: Levels use the same staff scale as the senior team: Poor (<30), Basic (30–44), Competent (45–59), Strong (60–74), Elite (75–89) and World Class (90+).
staff.directorActiveBonus: Up to {{value}}% Youth equipment purchasing discount
staff.coachActiveBonus: Development score {{score}}: affects weekly progression, readiness and race selection
staff.scoutActiveBonus: Scout score {{score}}: up to {{reports}} reports per search with stronger assessment accuracy

budget.title: Season Academy budget
budget.scoutingHelp: {{range}} scouting programme cost. Scouting reach is controlled by budget, not infrastructure.
budget.initialAllocationHelp: The amount assigned when the Academy was activated. This historical allocation does not change later.
budget.includesIncomeTransfers: Includes race income and later budget transfers.
budget.seniorBalanceHelp: Available senior-team cash before any new transfer.
budget.transferHelp: Race income remains in the Youth Academy automatically. Use this control only when you deliberately want to move money between the senior team and the Academy.

scouting.title: Youth scouting range
scouting.description: Choose where the Youth Scout may search. Scout quality determines how many prospects are found and how useful the assessments are; budget only determines geographic reach.
scouting.skillNote: A Worldwide programme does not guarantee elite prospects. It only gives the scout permission to search globally.
scouting.qualityExplainer: Budget determines where the scout can search. Scout quality determines how many riders are reported, how accurately they are assessed and how effectively stronger prospects are identified.
scouting.noScout: Hire a Youth Scout to begin active monthly prospect discovery. The Academy can operate without one, but no new scout reports will be generated.
scouting.cycleCompleted: {{count}} scouting report(s) delivered this game month. The next cycle opens next game month.
scouting.cycleReady: This month's scouting cycle is ready.
scouting.directorModeHelp: The Director shortlists prospects that meet your safeguards. If negotiations are also delegated, the Director may submit offers automatically within those limits.
scouting.managerModeHelp: You review every report and decide which prospects receive an offer.
scouting.autoRuleSummary: Auto-recruit from {{band}} · max {{stipend}}/week · max compensation {{compensation}} · keep {{slots}} free slot(s).
scouting.noReportsHelp: Run the monthly scouting cycle after hiring a Youth Scout. Reports expire after 60 game days.
scouting.offerHelp: The rider and family consider location, accommodation, staff quality and the support package. An AI Academy can also accept or reject the proposed development compensation.

offerStatusHelp.academy_rejected: Increase the development compensation if you want to try again.
offerStatusHelp.rider_rejected: You can improve the stipend or accommodation package and try again.
offerStatusHelp.accepted: The rider has joined your Youth Academy.

incoming.title: Incoming Academy approaches
incoming.noneHelp: Other Premium academies can approach your Youth Riders directly. Offers waiting for your decision will appear here.
incoming.decisionHelp: Accepting the Academy offer allows the rider and family to make the final relocation decision. Declining keeps the rider in your Academy.

scouting.weeklyRule: 1 free search + up to 3 Coin searches per in-game week
scouting.boostPrices: Extra search cost: Local 10 · Regional 15 · Continental 20 · Worldwide 30 Coins.

settings.title: Responsibilities
settings.description: Choose who handles routine Youth Academy decisions. The manager can always change these responsibilities later.
settings.autoRecruitmentDescription: These limits apply only when recruitment is delegated to the Youth Academy Director. Automatic offers require negotiations to be delegated as well.
settings.recruitmentHelp: Decides which scouted prospects should enter the Academy recruitment process and whether the Academy actively pursues a rider.
settings.raceEntryHelp: Decides which Youth race invitations are accepted or declined and which events the Academy will enter.
settings.raceSquadHelp: Selects the riders and race strategy for each entered Youth event, including rotation between simultaneous races.
settings.campsHelp: Approves Youth Academy camps and the related use of Academy funds when camp opportunities are available.
settings.equipmentHelp: Controls Youth equipment purchasing. The Academy Director can automatically fill missing equipment within the available Academy budget.
settings.negotiationsHelp: Manages stipend, accommodation and development-compensation offers after a Youth prospect has been identified.

equipment.title: Youth equipment
equipment.description: The Youth Academy owns separate U16 equipment. It reuses lower-cost tier 1–2 models from the existing equipment catalogue and pays for them from the Academy season budget.
equipment.directorHelp: The Youth Academy Director buys the lowest-cost eligible missing equipment by category while respecting the remaining Academy budget.
equipment.noInventory: The Youth Academy does not own equipment yet.
equipment.catalogHelp: Only durable tier 1–2 equipment from the existing club catalogue is available here. These are separate Youth Academy purchases and do not use professional club cash.
equipment.overviewOwnedHelp: Durable Youth Academy equipment currently owned.
equipment.overviewMarketHelp: Youth-approved Tier 1–2 equipment available to buy.
equipment.marketDelegated: Equipment purchasing is delegated to the Youth Academy Director. You can review the market here, while the Director uses the Academy budget and role bonus when filling equipment needs.

training.title: Youth development philosophy
training.description: Set the Academy's broad training priority. The U16 Head Coach converts this into individual workloads and development focus while protecting readiness and fatigue.

graduation.title: Age-16 graduation decisions
graduation.none: No Youth Riders currently require a graduation decision.
graduation.decisionHelp: At age 16, choose the rider's next pathway. Direct promotion to the First Squad is not the normal route.
graduation.pathwayHelp: This temporary pathway gives you 30 game days to move the rider into the Developing Team. If no Developing Team move is completed by then, the rider becomes a professional free agent.

calendar.title: U16 race calendar
calendar.ageLimitHelp: Youth racing is results-only. World Class, Continental and Regional events use age-based rolling start limits, rider readiness and fatigue. Separate Academy squads may race at the same time, but one rider cannot be selected for overlapping events.
calendar.qualificationHelp: This event is visible, but your Academy does not currently have an active invitation or enough eligible riders.
calendar.coachEntryHelp: Race participation is delegated. The U16 Head Coach reviews this event seven game days before the race and enters it only when the roster, fatigue and development plan fit.
calendar.coachLineupHelp: The U16 Head Coach selected {{count}} rider(s) and controls race strategy.
calendar.didNotRace: Your Academy did not race this event.
calendar.planHelp: The plan limits how many races the Academy may enter this month and how much can be spent. The U16 Head Coach can rotate separate squads across simultaneous races, but the same rider cannot be booked into overlapping events.
calendar.worldVisible: World Class races are shown globally
calendar.regionalVisible: Regional races are limited to your home division
calendar.competitionHelp: World Class, Continental and Regional events use age-based start limits, rider readiness and fatigue. Separate Academy squads may race at the same time, but the same rider cannot be selected for overlapping events.
calendar.browserHelp: This browser shows the complete Youth race calendar for the selected month. Use My Academy opportunities to narrow it to invitations and your home Regional division.
calendar.prelaunchHelp: This event is kept in the calendar for completeness. It was already in the past when the Youth competition system was launched, so no result was generated.

rankings.title: Youth Rankings
rankings.description: Academy standings follow the Youth World Class, Continental West/East and Regional divisions. Rider rankings remain separate and are based on race results in your region and worldwide.
rankings.noPoints: No ranking points have been scored yet.
rankings.promotionNote: Promotion and relegation positions are prepared in the competition model. The exact promotion/relegation spots will be activated after those rules are finalized.
rankings.riderRankingHelp: Rider rankings are separate from Academy class standings.

reports.title: Youth Race Reports
reports.description: Internal Head Coach summaries are always stored in Academy History. Choose when completed races should also create an inbox report.

history.noReports: No Youth race reports recorded yet.

profile.notFound: Youth Rider profile could not be loaded.
